# NGC Testing Services

> > Full-service independent testing laboratory providing ASTM, UL, and NFPA-compliant fire, acoustical, structural, and analytical testing for building materials and assemblies.

NGC Testing Services operates a fully-accredited testing facility in Buffalo, New York, specializing in comprehensive material and assembly testing across multiple disciplines. The laboratory serves North American clients requiring compliance verification and performance data for building products and construction systems.

## Key Topics

- Fire Testing
- Acoustical Testing
- Structural Testing
- Analytical Testing
- ASTM Standards
- NFPA 285
- UL Certification
- Building Materials
- Sound Transmission Class
- Full-Scale Testing
- Buffalo, New York
- Accreditations
- Testing Standards
- Building Assemblies

## Core Testing Services

- [Acoustical Testing](https://www.ngctestingservices.com/acoustical-testing): Acoustical testing services with isolated test chambers and ASTM/ISO standards compliance.
- [Fire Testing](https://www.ngctestingservices.com/fire-testing): Full-scale fire testing for building materials and assemblies per ASTM/UL/NFPA standards.
- [Structural Testing](https://www.ngctestingservices.com/structural-testing): Structural testing including shear, racking, wind-load, and fenestration testing services.
- [Analytical Testing](https://www.ngctestingservices.com/analytical-testing): Analytical lab services for building materials using X-Ray Diffraction and SEM analysis.
- [Additional Testing Services](https://www.ngctestingservices.com/additional-testing): Customized testing programs and additional services using Instron Universal Testing equipment.
